description: This file defines functions for extracting and formatting version information from input dictionaries. It provides utility functions to parse version data either from a list or string and generate a version string.

methods.name: GetVersion(info)
methods.description: Extracts version components (major, minor, patch) from input info, handling list or string formats, and ensures default values if data is missing.

methods.name: GetVersionString(info)
methods.description: Generates a dot-separated version string from the version info using GetVersion.
